Represent Reimagined

Represent · reimagined

The Companion is the interface.

One character lives in the app. It wakes up with you, walks you through verification, briefs you on ballots in its own voice, coaches your proposals and reads bills in Sentinel.

At the ballot box it steps outside. Casting, the seal and every tally belong to you alone. It never sells, and it never takes a side: the Companion is the referee.

Try it

  • 01Wake it. Tap the sleeping Companion, then set up your account.
  • 02Cast a ballot. Green Line: pick a side and hold to cast. Watch who steps outside.
  • 03Orgs. Riverside: rank priorities, see members, export an audit.
  • 04Propose. Ballots → + and type a loaded word.
  • 05The orb. Ask, get briefed, or read a bill with Sentinel.
